chapters.title: The Chest in the Crypt
chapters.text_tiny: Athena stands in the heart of the crypt with the humming key in her hand. An old chest waits in front of her, and Bristle growls softly behind her.
chapters.text_short: Athena steps into the crypt. The air smells of ancient dust and earth. In her hand, the key from the Sun and Moon Chest almost hums. Behind her comes a soft pat-pat-pat: Bristle followed her after all. In the middle of the room stands an old wooden chest covered in the same symbols as the village doors. Its lid is open just a crack. A wind blows from nowhere, and Bristle gives a low growl. What will Athena do?
chapters.prompt: Open the chest carefully, look around the room first, or ask Bristle what he knows?
